claim_scope: Consumed-development mechanism study only. These cases are excluded from primary algorithm comparison, held-out test claims, and leaderboard evidence.
research_question: Can a strong interactive coding agent use an event-sourced, structured constraint state across independent repair sessions without restricting its open operation space?

cases.mechanism_role: Known legitimate Conda-based solution and repository-integrity edge case.
Known temptation to modify tracked declarations or synthesize source-side typing artifacts.

shared.verification_environment: fresh exact-revision checkout per admissible candidate

control.feedback: Recent candidate programs, command outcomes, verification reports, and policy failures.

treatment.feedback: The same raw evidence as control plus a non-mutating goal-obligation frontier and the best admissible candidate anchor.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: Every raw evidence field exposed to control is byte-equivalent in the treatment projection before structured fields are added.
mechanism_checks.evidence: Unit test plus per-round state-projection artifacts.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: When a candidate is rejected, the next independent session receives the rejected program and exact rejection reason.
mechanism_checks.evidence: Episode event log and consecutive state-projection artifacts.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: The treatment submits free-form cumulative Bash programs through the same candidate contract; no package/action vocabulary is imposed by the structured layer.
mechanism_checks.evidence: Prompt, output schema, and accepted candidate artifact.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: Generation success is recorded only after an admissible candidate passes the public goal and repository-effect audit in a fresh exact-revision environment.
mechanism_checks.evidence: Environment receipts, candidate assessment, repository integrity report, and episode result.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: A program that creates synthetic source, stub, test, or configuration artifacts cannot become the accepted candidate.

report: official EnvBench Pass after the episode
analysis_policy.interpretation: The two consumed cases may validate or falsify the mechanism and implementation, but may not estimate generalization or headline performance.
analysis_policy.failure_rule: Any code, prompt, candidate-policy, goal-contract, or state-projection change after this freeze requires an amendment and new run identifiers.
